import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Erdős Problem 603

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/603](https://www.erdosproblems.com/603)
-/

namespace Erdos603

open Cardinal Filter Asymptotics

/--
Let $(A_i)$ be a family of countably infinite sets such that $\lvert A_i\cap A_j\rvert \neq 2$ for
all $i\neq j$. Find the smallest cardinal $C$ such that $\cup A_i$ can always be coloured with at
most $C$ colours so that no $A_i$ is monochromatic.

GPT 5.4 Pro (prompted by Chojecki) proved there is no uniform bound on such $C$: for every cardinal
$C$ there is a family of countably infinite sets $(A_i)$ such that $\lvert A_i\cap A_j\rvert \neq 2$
for all $i\neq j$, and in any colouring of $\cup A_i$ with $C$ colours some $A_i$ is monochromatic.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 3 5]
theorem erdos_603 :
    ∀ C : Cardinal.{0}, ∃ (V : Type) (F : Set (Set V)),
    (∀ A ∈ F, Cardinal.mk A = ℵ₀) ∧
    F.Pairwise (fun (A B : Set V) ↦ Cardinal.mk ↥(A ∩ B) ≠ 2) ∧
    ⋃₀ F = Set.univ ∧
    ∀ c : V → C.out, ∃ A ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, c x = c y := by
  sorry

end Erdos603

reformulations.difference: Lean represents the indexed family by a set F of subsets, requires ⋃₀ F = Set.univ, and quantifies over maps V → C.out instead of describing colourings of the union with at most C colours.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Replacing an indexed family by its range preserves its union and monochromatic members. Repetitions are harmless: a countably infinite set intersects itself in ℵ₀ elements, not two. Conversely, F can be indexed by its subtype. Restricting the ambient type to the union preserves member and intersection cardinalities and identifies the relevant colourings, so the covering condition loses no generality. Cardinal.mk C.out = C, and every palette K with Cardinal.mk K ≤ C embeds into C.out; maps into C.out need not use every colour. Thus the final clause excludes exactly the proper colourings using at most C colours. Classical quantifier negation identifies the entire theorem with nonexistence of a uniform bound, the answer recorded by the source. The normalization, indexed-pairwise, palette and no-uniform-bound equivalences were checked in Lean.

Independent checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean and /workspace/review/normalization.lean compiled successfully, without using the problem's sorry theorem.
